title: DailyHoursCap billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = DailyHoursCap (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 4. Hours per timekeeper per day are at most a cap (within the invoice in R1). Parameters only: no rates, timekeepers or code descriptions, and no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.

maxHoursPerDay.description: The most hours one timekeeper may bill on one day. More than 0, at most 24.
